intro.t: Your partner says something you don't fully agree with. Don't just say no. Accept their point, then add yours. It's the most useful move in Part 3.

close.t: Brilliant. Accept, then add. That's how real discussions work.

reels.note: Kind to your partner, and you still keep your own view.

ex.t: {That's a good point, but} it's easy to get distracted at home.
ex.q: I think learning online is the most useful thing here.

ex.t: {That's a good point, but} you need to be really responsible.
ex.q: Babysitting is the best way to earn money.

ex.t: {That's a good point, but} students would just buy them outside school.
ex.q: Banning fizzy drinks would solve everything.

ex.t: {Fair enough, but} not every family can afford one.
ex.q: Getting a tutor is the most helpful idea.

ex.t: {Fair enough, but} it's hard to change what your family cooks.
ex.q: Eating less meat makes the biggest difference.

ex.t: {Fair enough, but} you can't go on holiday every week.
ex.q: Going on holiday brings families closer.

reels.p: I see what you mean, but …
reels.bt: I see what you mean, but…
reels.note: Proves you understood before you disagree.

ex.t: {I see what you mean, but} some of them are really creative.
ex.q: Video games are a total waste of time.

ex.t: {I see what you mean, but} it helps me keep in touch with friends abroad.
ex.q: Social media is bad for friendships.

ex.t: {I see what you mean, but} a small job can teach you a lot.

reels.note: Sounds natural at fifteen. Perfectly fine at B2.

ex.t: {I get that, but} we usually end up chatting instead.
ex.q: Studying with friends is more fun.

ex.t: {I get that, but} you have to take photos and answer messages all day.
ex.q: Selling things online is easy money.

ex.t: {I get that, but} it's much cheaper than a car.

reels.p: I'd agree up to a point.
reels.bt: I'd agree up to a point.

ex.t: {I'd agree up to a point.} They should be banned in lessons, but not at break.
ex.q: Phones should be banned at school.

ex.t: {I'd agree up to a point.} But students should choose which sport.
ex.q: Sport should be compulsory for everyone.

ex.t: {I'd agree up to a point.} Technology will help, but the climate worries me.
ex.q: Life will be better in fifty years.

reels.p: That's one way of looking at it.
reels.bt: That's one way of looking at it.
reels.note: The calmest way to say "I see it differently".

ex.t: {That's one way of looking at it,} but once in a while often becomes every day.
ex.q: Fast food is fine once in a while.

ex.t: {That's one way of looking at it,} but if everyone does it, it adds up.
ex.q: Recycling at home doesn't really change anything.

ex.t: {That's one way of looking at it,} but lots of people just copy from the internet.
ex.q: Homework teaches you to work alone.
